description: AI-ready banking starts with data – but only if it's unified. Hong Leong Bank's CITO William Streitberg explains how consolidating hundreds of fragmented systems into a single data lake enabled real-time intelligence, better fraud detection, and more personalized services. In this #TransformTalks interview, he shares why disciplined architecture and long-term partnerships made it possible.
